// diagnostic

E1241

The staged `core.{ring}` artifact is missing for this platform.

What

The staged `core.{ring}` artifact is missing for this platform.

Why

The active toolchain object carries prebuilt ring artifacts, but none for `core.{ring}` on this platform (D-JPK-RINGSHIP1).

Fix

The build falls back to the compiler-embedded `core.{ring}`; to ship the staged artifact, realize a toolchain object built for this platform (`jet update jet`).
